title: Play Site Dev Server Fixes
description: Fix compose/sites/play Vite dev: duplicate Connector import in compose/sketchpad/index.tsx; missing @compose/rs-wasm resolve when bundling @compose/js (add alias in play vite.config.ts like js/react).
summary: Fixed compose/sites/play Vite dev: (1) Removed duplicate `Connector` binding in compose/sketchpad/index.tsx — it was both `import type` and a value import; kept type-only. (2) Added resolve.alias `@compose/rs-wasm` → compose/rs/pkg in compose/sites/play/vite.config.ts so dynamic imports from @compose/js resolve like react/js builds. (3) Dropped obsolete qualityConfig import/register from compose/sites/play/index.tsx (Quality app removed from sketchpad). Verified with `npx vite build` from compose/sites/play (NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=12288) — build completed successfully.
